Isolated Change Proposals -- frozen evidence -> independent edits -> reviewed publication
|
|-- Model: [M] modular structure, [C] calls, [O] ownership; [D] data dependencies cross these boundaries
|
|-- [M] ChangeSessionService -- proposal boundary between repository evidence and canvas publication
|   |-- Exposes capture/create, snapshot/apply/update, preview/readDiffTree/readTreemaps, accept
|   |-- Dependencies
|   |   |-- DiagramChangeSessionRepository -> proposal reads, summaries, previews and writes
|   |   |-- DiagramRepository.repositories -> resolveContext() and captureHunks()
|   |   |-- DiagramRepository.projectCatalogs -> saved baselines and acceptance receipts
|   |   `-- CanvasSessionPort -> inspect live workspaces and dispatch snapshot/document-state
|   |-- Private machinery: serialize(), mutate(), controller(), record(), validateReady()
|   |   `-- [O] queues[id] retains pending work; settlement removes the current queue tail
|   |
|   |-- [C] capture(input) freezes inputs without creating a proposal
|   |   |-- repositories.resolveContext(input) -> captureHunks(context)
|   |   |   `-- [D] repositoryId + commits + head + optional comparisonBase -> GitDiffHunk[]
|   |   |-- projectCatalogs.loadCurrentRepresentationCatalog() or loadRepresentationCatalog()
|   |   |   `-- settled representations in the selected repository -> documentFromRevision()
|   |   |-- bridge.list() -> bridge.dispatch(..., method: 'snapshot', currentRevisions: true)
|   |   |   |-- selected live drafts replace corresponding catalog baselines in documents
|   |   |   |-- multiple live workspaces require canvasId; repository changes reject capture
|   |   |   `-- savedRevisionId + capturedVersion retain the captured document's context
|   |   `-- baselineChangeSessionId supplied -> reuse original context, hunks and baselines
|   |       `-- excludes new proposal-only canvases; starts again from original baseline states
|   |
|   |-- [O] ChangeSessionCapture -> cloned ChangeSessionDocument[]
|   |   |-- baseline: ChangeDocumentState | null -> retained comparison state
|   |   |-- proposed: ChangeDocumentState -> independently editable document + canvas
|   |   |-- history: CanvasHistoryRecord -> forkHistory() creates a separate history context
|   |   `-- version / representationId / savedRevisionId / repositoryId -> identity and guards
|   |
|   `-- [C] create(input, captured?) -> repository.write(DiagramChangeSession)
|       |-- [D] projectId + requestId -> deterministic change-<sha256 prefix> identity
|       |-- input + stateKey(captured), when supplied -> receipts.create.signature
|       |   `-- same signature returns prior result; changed arguments raise REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|       |-- context present -> writeDiffTree(input.diffTree, hunks) or defaultDiffTree(hunks)
|       `-- status: 'draft', version: 0, changes: [], receipts.create -> saved isolated proposal
|
|-- [M] Automated entry -- PushIntegrationService and DiffSessionWorkflowService
|   |-- [C] PushIntegrationService.receive(connectionId, raw, format)
|   |   |-- pushEventSchema.parse() or decodeArtifactsPush() -> normalized event
|   |   |-- [D] connectionId + event.eventId -> deterministic push generation ID
|   |   |   `-- existing generation must contain the same event or PUSH_EVENT_ID_CONFLICT
|   |   |-- connection.enabled + service.enabled -> admission for a new generation
|   |   |-- non-branch ref / deleted branch / unchanged ref -> status: 'skipped'
|   |   `-- source.resolve(connection, event)
|   |       |-- hasChanges false -> skip a push with no net content changes
|   |       `-- workflow.start({ requestId: id, repositoryId, commits, head, comparisonBase })
|   |           `-- [D] event.after -> head; event.before -> comparisonBase
|   |-- [O] PushIntegrationService.pending[id] shares simultaneous delivery execution
|   |   |-- store.createGeneration() reserves the generation; saveGeneration() retains outcome
|   |   `-- finally deletes pending[id]; get() refreshes a running generation from workflow.get()
|   |
|   |-- [C] DiffSessionWorkflowService.start(raw) -> begin() -> execute(run, signal)
|   |   |-- requireAiEnabled() + diffSessionRequestSchema.parse() -> validated request
|   |   |-- [D] requestId -> diff-run-<sha256 prefix>; stored request must match on replay
|   |   |-- changes.capture(run.request) -> require pinned context and nonempty hunks
|   |   |-- store.artifact('context', capture), loadPrompts(), store.artifact('prompts', prompts)
|   |   |-- runtime.openSession({ signal, tools: step => tools.tools(step), ... })
|   |   `-- runAgentWorkflow(createDiffSessionWorkflow(prompts, capture), ...)
|   |       |-- analyze -> session.runStep(request) with read tools
|   |       |-- materialize -> session.runStep(request) with proposal mutation tools
|   |       `-- validate -> changes.get(result.changeSessionId)
|   |           `-- ID must equal tools.changeSessionId and status must be 'ready'
|   |               `-- run.status = 'completed': proposal is ready for review
|   |
|   |-- [M] DiffSessionTools.tools(step) enforces stage and target boundaries
|   |   |-- analyze exposes canvas-api-search, diagram-search, get_repository_diff_hunks,
|   |   |   read_repository_source
|   |   |   |-- frozenSearch() -> capture.documents[].baseline, independent of later live edits
|   |   |   `-- captured hunks + injected DiffSessionSourceReader -> pinned analysis evidence
|   |   |-- materialize adds create_diagram_change_session -> changes.create(..., capture)
|   |   |   |-- exec / draw_diagram / set_diagram_source_mappings
|   |   |   |-- update_diagram_change_session / read_change_session_diff_tree
|   |   |   `-- [C] bound(input) -> agent.call(name, input with this.changeSessionId)
|   |   |       `-- rejects another proposal's ID; this tool set exposes no acceptance tool
|   |   `-- complete_diff_session -> require ready status, changes and complete hunk coverage
|   |       `-- [D] capture.hunks[].id minus diffTree.mappings[].targets[].hunkId -> missing evidence
|   |
|   `-- [O] Workflow service owns starts, active AbortControllers, live runs and agent session
|       |-- store retains step requests/responses, context, prompts, transcript and metrics
|       |-- cancel(id) -> abort; execute() records cancelled or failed status on error
|       |-- finally -> session.dispose() + save(); execution settlement clears active/live
|       `-- get() reports 'interrupted' when a running record has no active/start entry
|
|-- [M] Proposal editing -- shared MappingDocumentController with proposal-owned history
|   |-- [C] ChangeSessionService.apply(id, documentId, version, operations, requestId)
|   |   `-- mutate() -> controller(doc).applyUpdate(version, operations) -> record()
|   |       |-- [O] doc.history = controller.exportHistory()
|   |       |-- doc.proposed = snapshot.document + snapshot.canvas + head checkpoint nodeOrigins
|   |       |-- doc.version = snapshot.version; legacy doc.past/doc.future become empty
|   |       `-- refreshChanges() -> recompute affected changes; session.status = 'draft'
|   |-- [C] createDocument() -> draft-<UUID>, baseline: null, initial canvas and controller history
|   |-- [C] update({ action: 'undo' | 'redo' | 'reset', documentId, expectedVersion })
|   |   `-- controller.undo()/reset() -> record() -> refreshChanges(); reset requires a baseline
|   |
|   |-- [D] refreshChanges(): baseline + proposed + incident edges -> DiagramChange[]
|   |   |-- baseline absent -> type 3, canvas:<documentId>
|   |   |-- revisionReviews/revisionSelections differ -> type 1, variants:<documentId>
|   |   |-- changed diagram content or incident edges -> diagram:<documentId>:<nodeId>
|   |   |   `-- existing baseline node -> type 1; added node -> type 2
|   |   `-- matching previous change retains title/reasons/dependsOn and type-4 annotation
|   |
|   |-- [O] mutate() retains receipts['request:' + requestId] = { signature, result }
|   |   |-- replay receipt checked before editing; signature mismatch rejects reuse
|   |   |-- archived/accepted proposals reject edits; mutation receipt capacity is bounded
|   |   |-- session.version increments; document versions identify which documents to write
|   |   `-- request() separately retains receipts['api:' + requestId] for bound API replay
|   |
|   `-- [C] update({ status: 'ready' }) -> private validateReady(session)
|       |-- validateDiffTree(), repository ownership and migrationIssues() must pass
|       |-- changes must be nonempty; dependsOn references must exist and be acyclic
|       |-- validateConnectionAnchor() checks both ends of every proposed edge
|       `-- type-2 added diagram needs an incoming edge from a diagram present in baseline
|           `-- readiness gates acceptance; edits can return the proposal to draft

|-- [M] Evidence model -- DiagramChangeSession and ChangeSessionDiffTree
|   |-- DiagramChangeSession exposes documents[], changes[], migrations?, receipts and acceptance?
|   |   |-- status: draft | ready | accepted | archived; version tracks proposal mutations
|   |   `-- validateChangeSession() checks repository context, document states and histories
|   |-- [O] ChangeSessionDiffTree retains revision: DiagramRevision, mappings[], hunks[]
|   |   |-- mappings: { id, nodeId, targets: [{ kind: 'diff-hunk', hunkId }], diagramTargets? }
|   |   `-- captured hunks remain attached to the proposal's pinned repository context
|   |-- [C] writeDiffTree(input, hunks, previous?)
|   |   |-- previous.revision.id must match input.expectedRevisionId
|   |   |-- createStoredDiagram()/reviseStoredDiagram() -> revision with stable node references
|   |   |-- [D] mapping.source.line + parsed nodes + revision.nodeRefs -> mapping.nodeId
|   |   `-- replace mappings with the tree; validateDiffTree() rejects stale nodes/unknown hunks
|   |-- [D] validateChangeSession(): repository context constrains each hunk
|   |   |-- comparisonBase defined -> hunk.commit === head and hunk.parent === comparisonBase
|   |   `-- otherwise -> hunk.commit belongs to commits; repositoryId must match
|   `-- [C] readDiffTree() -> resolveDiffTreeHunks(tree, nodeIds) -> hunkPage()
|       |-- [D] selected nodes + mappings + captured hunks -> deduplicated evidence selection
|       `-- node/hunk selection, pagination and includePatches control the returned detail
|
|-- [M] Durable proposal storage -- ChangeSessionRecords
|   |-- Exposes readSummary/readPreview/readDiffTree/read/write; hides blob splitting and manifests
|   |-- [O] Manifest { format: 2, summary, documents, receipts, diffTree? }
|   |   |-- documents[documentId] -> immutable StoredDocument reference
|   |   |   |-- metadata + baseline/proposed references
|   |   |   `-- history.header + history.checkpoints[id] -> separately stored history records
|   |   |-- receipts -> immutable map of receipt references; diffTree -> stored evidence tree
|   |   `-- DiagramPersistence -> shared diagram persistence; ImmutableRecords -> proposal blobs
|   |
|   |-- [C] write(SessionWrite) -> serial(projectId, id, ...)
|   |   |-- [D] optional input.expected + token(previous manifest) -> conflict check
|   |   |-- splitDocument() and blobs.put() store supplied documents and receipts
|   |   |-- unchanged document references survive; summary/tree consistency is validated
|   |   `-- publishJson(manifestFile, manifest) -> returned token identifies the saved manifest
|   |-- [O] module-level queues serialize writes by manifest path and release settled tails
|   |
|   `-- Scoped reads keep review cheaper than full restoration
|       |-- readSummary() -> metadata; readPreview() -> baseline/proposed without undo history
|       |-- read() -> full documents, histories, receipts and DiffTree; returns { session, token }
|       |-- [O] validated/previews caches retain up to 16 entries each; callers receive clones
|       `-- [C] ChangeSessionService.readTreemaps() -> scoped previews in batches of four
|           `-- [D] captured summary version + every preview + final summary -> coherent result
|               `-- mismatch raises VERSION_CONFLICT instead of returning mixed generations
|
`-- [C] ChangeSessionService.accept({ changeSessionId, requestId, expectedVersion })
    |-- serialize(id) -> get(id) -> existing acceptance replay or version/readiness checks
    |   `-- replay requires matching acceptance.requestId and acceptance.sessionVersion
    |-- [D] session.changes[].documentId -> affected documents only
    |-- Live baseline guard: bridge.list() -> dispatch(method: 'document-state')
    |   |-- match affected documentId or representationId across project workspaces
    |   `-- current document stateKey + name must match captured baseline document + doc.name
    |       `-- changed live canvas -> VERSION_CONFLICT; caller must create a new proposal
    |
    |-- [C] projectCatalogs.acceptCanvasChanges(projectId, payload)
    |   |-- [D] savedRevisionId -> expectedRevisionId: published baseline precondition
    |   |-- proposed.document + controller(doc).exportHistory() -> publication content
    |   |-- session.id/version + requestId + changeIds -> acceptance identity
    |   `-- returns ChangeSessionAcceptance; catalog implementation is outside supplied sources
    |
    `-- [O] Catalog acceptance receipt survives an interrupted proposal-record update
        |-- acceptance.documents[] retains before/after checkpoints and proposedCheckpointId
        |-- [C] finishAcceptance() -> status: 'accepted', version: sessionVersion + 1
        |   `-- repository.write(session, { documents: [], receipts: [] }) saves acceptance metadata
        |-- get()/accept() recover a ready record through loadChangeSessionAcceptances()
        `-- list()/effectiveSummary() project accepted status from the matching catalog receipt
